t: Said in prostration, covering every category
a: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
p: Allāhumma-ghfir lī dhanbī kullahu, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa ākhirah, wa ʿalāniyatahu wa sirrah.
m: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the hidden.
